title: How do you validate AI generated trading strategies?
author: PineGenAI_Official
selftext:
Hey traders! 

AI is making it much easier to come up with trading ideas and strategies, but the tricky part is figuring out if they actually work or if they just look good on paper.

A strategy might show great results in backtesting, but the real market can be a different story. market conditions change, risk management matters, and unexpected situations can affect the outcome.

Curious to hear from the community:

How do you decide if an AI generated strategy is worth testing further?

Would love to hear how others approach this.
